_meta.purpose: The review checker's own category answer (D-117). The Gemini drafter proposes a category; the checker confirms it only when the pack declares that category itself, or when exactly one rule below gives the same code. No rule, or rules that disagree, means no answer: the item goes to a person.
_meta.basis: Codex CXS 192-1995 (General Standard for Food Additives), Part II food category descriptors, read 2026-09-27 from fao.org/input/download/standards/4/CXS_192_2015e.pdf. FSSAI Appendix A uses the Codex food category system (data/food_categories.json).
_meta.how: name_any: a phrase in the product name or variant. label_any: a phrase anywhere in the back label's text (Cloud Vision), for the generic name a pack prints. sugar_in_first: an added-sugar name (normalization.json) among the first N ingredients. no_added_sugar: no added-sugar name in any ingredient. first_ingredient_any: the first ingredient starts with one of these. name_none: none of these phrases in the name or variant. Every condition given must hold.
_meta.keep_it_small: A wrong rule that agrees with a wrong draft would publish a wrong category. Add a rule only for product types seen in the catalogue, with a descriptor read for it, and a test.
